headword: {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}

definitions.explanation: medical care focused on comfort and quality of life for patients with terminal illnesses who are nearing death

examples.japanese: {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think about the way end-of-life care should be.

examples.japanese: {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: In end-of-life care, relieving the patient's pain is the most important thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進展|しんてん}→進展：14374_shinten⟧⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧、{終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: As the aging society progresses, interest in end-of-life care is growing.

notes:
Medical care provided to patients with incurable, terminal conditions, focusing on comfort rather than cure. Composed of ⟦{終末|しゅうまつ}→終末：29777_shuumatsu⟧ (end, final stage) + ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧ (medical care). This is a major topic in Japanese society given the rapidly aging population.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ — the way end-of-life care should be
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to receive end-of-life care
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{携|たずさ}わる→携わる：09333_tazusawaru⟧ — to be involved in end-of-life care
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧ — the end-of-life care setting

KEY CONCEPTS:
- ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧ — palliative care (focuses on pain relief and comfort)
- ホスピス — hospice (specialized facility for terminal patients)
- ⟦{尊厳死|そんげんし}→尊厳死：24583_songenshi⟧ — death with dignity
- ⟦{延命|えんめい}→延命：12484_enmei⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ — life-prolonging treatment
- ⟦{看取|みと}り→看取る：20215_mitoru⟧ — watching over a dying person (attending to someone at the end of life)

- ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧ — palliative care (broader; not limited to the very end of life)
